CONCEPT PROJECT / PACKAGING · VISUAL IDENTITY

Forma↗

An earthy, expressive packaging world for an everyday botanical collection.

ROLE
Packaging · Visual identity
TIMELINE
5-week concept
STATUS
Concept / 2026
TOOLS
Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma
01 / THE CHALLENGE

How can a botanical range feel calm and considered without disappearing on a shelf?

The approach

Sculptural letterforms, generous space, and a simple colour code let each product feel individual while belonging to a family.

The intended outcome

An adaptable concept range with packaging, stationery, and a digital shop direction. Material choices and accessibility would be validated before production.

Illustrative concept. No real client, launch, or measured results are claimed.
EXPLORE THE DETAILS
01 / 03
02 / BEHIND THE IDEA

From a question
to a point of view.

01 — RESEARCH

Find the right question.

Compared ingredient labels and explored how people distinguish everyday products. Clear hierarchy became the central design requirement.

02 — SKETCH & EXPLORE

Follow a few loose threads.

Paper silhouettes and bottle studies helped balance shelf presence with a quieter, more tactile character.

03 — DESIGN & REFINE

Make the idea tangible.

One organic shape anchors each composition. The muted palette leaves space for product information and tactile materials.

04 / WHAT I’M TAKING FORWARD

Little details.
Lasting lessons.

Restraint works best with one confident gesture. The oversized botanical form gave a quiet system a distinctive signature.
